query: Plan a 10k for tomorrow morning and make me a playlist for it
expected_behavior: Recognises both capabilities are wanted and does planning first, because the projected finish time is the playlist's duration input
Reads references/run-planning.md and references/run-playlist.md, and no others
Runs scripts/planning/plan_run.py 10, then scripts/playlist/build_playlist.py 10, passing the same distance through rather than guessing a duration
Reads the pinned playlist id from scripts/cache.py show playlist_state instead of from the reference markdown
Follows the printed Spotify call sequence in order: remove_from_library on the pinned id, generate_playlist, save_to_library
Writes the new playlist id back with scripts/cache.py put playlist_state, and does not edit references/run-playlist.md to record it
Mentions that Spotify cannot rename a playlist, so Karan renames the new one himself
